aim: Generate cinematic scene images for the Ledras Lament narrative using fal.ai FLUX Control LoRA Canny, driven by a Canny edge map of a fixed amphitheater stage guide.

settings.imagine-config.json: Runtime config: model, resolution, control_lora_image_url (stage guide), seed, scene file path, output dir.
settings.gateway.json: Token budget for fal.ai API calls. Deducted per generation. Resets to 1 on manual edit.

stage/.aim: Guide images for Canny edge conditioning — the architectural invariant that all generations conform to.

2do/.aim: Persistent task management and project workflow tracking.
key: README.md — Comprehensive project task overview and status reporting.
task_log.json — Machine-readable task tracking and dependency management.
reports/ — Historical task execution reports and evidence collection.

data/scenes/.aim: Multi-moment scene configuration files for sequential image generation.
data/scenes/.key: ledras_scenes_v11_moments.json — 6-moment Desert Moon Portal scene definitions with hyperrealistic visual specifications.

data/sources/.aim: Canonical scene definitions, moment configurations, and favorites registry.
key: ledras_scenes_v11_moments.json — 6-moment Desert Moon Portal sequence definitions.
fav_prompts.json — Lightweight favorite prompts overlay linked by request_id and subscene_id

tests/.key: test_fal_generate.py — Updated assertions: resolution mapping, cost est, prompt building, schema compliance, subscene prompts, filename format (v300 seed), upload_file integration, retry logic, and progress reporting.

key: generation_log.jsonl — append-only URL log for failed-download recovery, including retry attempts and status.

assets/generated/prelude-intro-moments/.aim: Generated 6-moment Desert Moon Portal Sequence images.
key: scene-03_v2023298968_20260909_114627.png — Moment 3: Blood Moon Portal Activation

recyclebin/.aim: Archived legacy files. No active code depends on these.

docs/.aim: Reference docs, context, production notes, and usage guides. Not consumed by code.
key: usage/moment-generation-guide.md — 6-moment Desert Moon Portal Sequence setup and execution instructions.

specific_scenes/.aim: Standalone scene documentation and enhanced prompt definitions for specialized sequences.
key: prelude-intro-moments.md — Hyperrealistic photorealistic prompt documentation for 6-moment Desert Moon Portal Sequence.
prelude-intro.md — Context documentation for Prelude-Intro scene.

root_files: fal_generate.py — Main generator with local control image upload, bounded exponential backoff retry, and ProgressReporter. CLI: `python3 fal_generate.py [scene_ids]`; `--subscenes` for narrative subscene generation.
README.md — Project documentation, config model, quick start.
imagine-config.json — Sole config source (see settings above).
theteam.config — Team role definitions and methodology tracking (sequence_moment_tracking).
